name: @cloudguard/web
//: M0 dependencies ONLY. Clerk (M1), Recharts (M5) and Stripe (M8) are added at their milestone. An unused dependency is unaudited attack surface — and `npm audit` in CI blocks a merge on a critical CVE, so every package we add is a package we have to keep patching.
//tanstack: Server-state cache. NOT a global store — see docs/06 § State management: four kinds of state, four tools. Redux/Zustand are deliberately absent.
//shadcn-primitives: shadcn/ui is NOT a dependency — it copies source into components/ui/ so we own it. These are the headless Radix primitives and styling utilities those copied components import.
//tailwind-v4: v4 is configured in CSS (@theme in globals.css), not in a tailwind.config.js. That is why no such file exists — its absence is intentional, not an omission.
//overrides: Next.js bundles its own older PostCSS copy, which npm audit flags as high severity. Force every copy onto the patched release until Next ships one.
